Subject: CAIQ deep-dive / evidence sync

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. MeridianX is hoping to run a focused CAIQ walk-through next week to align on evidence handoff and to confirm which log samples and architecture diagrams will satisfy our audit team. We put together an initial matrix (attached) that maps CAIQ sections to potential MeridianX artifacts — can you please take a look?

Availability: we are in US Eastern (EDT) but have two security folks on Pacific time. Proposed windows: 2026-09-23 10:00–11:00 PDT or 2026-09-24 14:00–15:00 PDT. If neither works, tell us two 1-hour windows that do.

Pre-reads and asks from our side:
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) or confirmation of availability
- Sample logs (auth, api access logs) for a 30-day window
- Network diagram showing egress controls and VPC peering

Attachment: MeridianX_CAIX_initial_matrix.xlsx (CAIQ mapping)

Best,
Alex Murray
Head of Security, MeridianX

Alex — thanks for the matrix and the clarity on asks. We can cover all of this in a 60-minute session. 2026-09-23 10:00 PDT works for Connor + one of our security engineers; if MeridianX prefers the 24th we can try to free up David.

Quick answers up-front:
- SOC 2 Type II: we have a redacted report we can share in advance.
- Logs: Hannah will pull an anonymized 30-day sample (redacted PII).
- Network diagram: I will attach our current VPC/peering diagram and a short write-up of egress controls.

Proposed agenda (draft):
1) 10m — Introductions & scope (who needs which CAIQ sections)
2) 25m — Walk through their matrix and clarifying questions
3) 15m — Evidence mapping & handoff plan (who provides what, timelines)
4) 10m — Next steps & owners

Action owners (internal):
- Hannah: pull anonymized log sample and confirm format (redwood-anon-log-sample.tar.gz)
- David: prepare SOC 2 redacted export (redwood-soc2-redacted.pdf)
- Marissa: schedule the meeting and send calendar invite with conference link

I will attach the documents above to the calendar invite once Hannah and David confirm they are ready.

Connor O'Brien
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
